text: The structure is a rational linear equivalence preserving the bilinear form and mapping the integral carrier onto the target carrier. This is the embedded version of the bijective lattice homomorphism in [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3). Surjectivity on carriers is explicit; preservation of the form is not inferred from a bare module equivalence. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L352) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L362) passes.
Extending then restricting a form-preserving carrier equivalence recovers it.
Restricting then extending recovers the ambient isometry.

The coercion forgets the carrier and form-preservation proofs and retains the stored rational linear equivalence. It follows [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38); the underlying function is unchanged. Its codomain is V≃ₗ[ℚ]W, not an equivalence of carrier subtypes. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L102) passes.
The coerced linear equivalence has the same function.

The inverse ambient equivalence preserves the form and sends the target carrier back onto the source carrier. Thus it is the inverse lattice isometry of [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3) and [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38). Bijectivity is stored, so degeneracy of either form creates no ambiguity. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L172) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L176) passes.
The inverse after the original map returns each source vector.
The original map after the inverse returns each target vector.

Restricting the ambient map to L gives an ℤ-linear bijection L→M: carrier equality supplies both membership and surjectivity. This realizes the lattice isometry of [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3) on integral vectors. The inverse is the corresponding restriction of the ambient inverse. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L294) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L263) passes.
Restriction commutes with inversion.
The restricted map agrees with the ambient map on carrier vectors.

The restricted map preserves the integer-valued pairings. Both sides cast to the rational form-preservation equation, and injectivity of ℤ→ℚ gives equality. This is exactly the carrier-level isometry condition in [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3); it uses the supplied isometry, not only its underlying module equivalence. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L352) passes.
An equivalence with this form-preservation condition extends and restricts back exactly.

A carrier equivalence satisfying the explicit equality of integral pairings extends uniquely to the rational ambient spaces. Full carriers span those spaces, so bilinearity extends form preservation from a carrier basis. This reconstructs the isometry of [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3); the hform argument is essential even for degenerate forms. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L352) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L362) passes.
Restriction recovers the given carrier equivalence.
Extension recovers any isometry whose restriction was supplied.

Equality of the entire lattice structures identifies both carrier and form, allowing the identity ambient map to be a lattice isometry. This is equality transport of the identity in [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38), not an isometry inferred from equal ranks or equal carrier types. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L159) passes.
The transported identity acts as the identity on ambient vectors.

The identity rational linear equivalence preserves the form and maps the carrier to itself. This is precisely the identity lattice isometry in [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3), using the identity bilinear isometry of [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38). It works for every integral lattice, including degenerate and zero-rank ones. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L151) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L287) passes.
The identity isometry fixes every ambient vector.
Its restriction is the identity on the carrier.

Composition sends x to f(e(x)); preservation of pairings and equality of carrier images compose in the same order. This is composition of the isometries in [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3) and [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38). The intermediate lattice is shared explicitly, and no commutativity of composition is asserted. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L195) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L301) passes.
The ambient action is f after e.
Carrier restrictions compose in the same order.

This is the same ambient bijection with scalars restricted from ℚ to ℤ. Restriction is valid because a rational linear map respects integer scalars. It implements the underlying-module view of [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38); the carrier restriction is a separate construction. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L121) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L248) passes.
Restricting scalars leaves every value unchanged.
Restricting scalars commutes with inversion.

For x in the source carrier, forgetting the target membership proof after applying carrierEquiv gives exactly e(x) in the ambient target. This is the restriction of the isometry in [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3). The equality does not choose a new representative or alter x by scalar extension. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L352) passes.
The restriction of the rational extension is exactly the supplied carrier map.

The instance exposes the stored ambient bijection, its inverse and both inverse identities. Extensional equality follows because the remaining structure fields are propositions. This is the same function-like interface as [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38); equality of norms alone is not used to identify maps. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L172) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L176) passes.
The exposed inverse is a left inverse.
It is also a right inverse.

The equality M.form(e(x),e(y))=L.form(x,y) is the defining form-preservation condition of [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3) and [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38). It holds for all ambient rational vectors, not just carrier vectors. The wrapper supplies the arguments in the correct order despite the upstream theorem’s reversed binder order. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L309) passes.
Restriction gives the corresponding equality of integral pairings.

Reading the ambient rational equivalence as ℤ-linear does not change its action on any vector. Both sides evaluate the same stored function of [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38). This concerns the whole ambient space; no membership in the lattice carrier is required. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L237) passes.
The analogous inverse evaluation also agrees.

The image e(x) belongs to the target carrier exactly when x belongs to the source carrier. The forward implication uses bijectivity together with equality of carrier images, not mere containment. This is the onto-carrier requirement in the embedded lattice isometry of [Dolgachev §1.1](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/idolga-new/wp-content/uploads/sites/1467/2024/08/bourbaki83.pdf#page=3). Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L263) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L267) passes.
The carrier restriction agrees with the ambient map.
The inverse restriction agrees with the inverse ambient map.

Inverting the lattice isometry and then restricting scalars gives the same ℤ-linear equivalence as inverting the scalar-restricted ambient map. Both have the same inverse function, as in [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38). No integral lattice is replaced by its dual. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L237) passes.
The equality has the intended value at every target vector.

The inverse of the scalar-restricted ambient equivalence sends y to e.symm(y). Both inverses arise from the same rational equivalence in [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38). The equality applies to every ambient target vector, irrespective of carrier membership. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L176) passes.
Applying the original map recovers y.

Applying e after its inverse returns the original target vector. This is the right-inverse law of the stored linear equivalence in [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38); it needs no positivity or nondegeneracy argument. Every target vector is allowed, including those outside the carrier. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L172) passes.
The companion left-inverse identity holds on source vectors.

The inverse lattice isometry and inverse ambient linear equivalence have the same underlying function, exactly as in [the pinned bilinear-isometry API](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/IsometryEquiv.lean#L38). The rendered signature prints both coercions similarly, but the source distinguishes the two bundled objects; the assertion verifies their agreement rather than adding a new inverse choice. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Isometry/Basic.lean#L237) passes.
After restricting scalars, inverse evaluation still agrees.

The interval contains precisely the ℤ-submodules M with L⊆M⊆Lᵛ. It is the underlying carrier interval in [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8), before imposing integrality or evenness. Degenerate L is allowed here; the definition correctly makes no claim that every such M is finitely generated. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L196) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L202) passes.
The zero subgroup yields L.
The whole subgroup yields Lᵛ.

For an integral lattice N sharing L’s form and containing L, the intermediate-carrier constructor stores N.carrier unchanged. This is the actual embedding chain underlying [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8). The equality does not substitute an abstract isomorphic carrier or weaken the common-form hypothesis. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L116) passes.
Membership of the associated quotient subgroup is detected on the actual ambient carrier.

This sends M to its quotient image M/L inside Lᵛ/L, using [the pinned quotient correspondence](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean#L284). It is the subgroup attached to an overlattice in [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8), extended to all intermediate carriers. No isotropy or evenness is asserted merely because this subgroup exists. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L116) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L208) passes.
A quotient representative lies in the subgroup exactly when it lies in M.
The forward map recovers every subgroup from its preimage.

Nondegeneracy makes Lᵛ a full finite ℤ-lattice. Its submodule M is finitely generated because ℤ is Noetherian, and M spans the ambient rational space because it contains L. This supplies the finite-rank setting of [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8); the nondegeneracy premise is essential for arbitrary M. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Index.lean#L244) passes.
The resulting full intermediate carrier has positive finite index over L.

If N contains L and has the same form, each x∈N pairs integrally with every y∈L because y also lies in N. Hence N⊆Lᵛ, giving the chain used in [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8). The construction explicitly retains the common-form and containment hypotheses; nondegeneracy is unnecessary. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L271) passes.
The constructed intermediate carrier is exactly N.carrier.

Quotienting the full preimage of H recovers H because Lᵛ→Lᵛ/L is surjective. This is the image-after-preimage identity of [the pinned quotient correspondence](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean#L284), underlying [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8). Equality is of the actual additive subgroups, with no finite-order hypothesis. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L143) passes.
The preimage has exactly the classes belonging to H.

The quotient images satisfy M/L⊆N/L exactly when M⊆N, since both carriers already contain L. This is the order-preserving direction of [the pinned quotient correspondence](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean#L284); it is not the order-reversing duality operation. It remains valid for degenerate lattices and infinite quotient groups. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L116) passes.
Representative membership detects containment in the original carrier.

The inverse construction takes the literal preimage of H in Lᵛ and regards it as an ambient ℤ-submodule. It necessarily contains L, the kernel of the quotient map. This is [the pinned quotient correspondence](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean#L284) underlying [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8); a subgroup alone does not imply that the induced form is integral. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L154) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L215) passes.
Ambient membership requires dual-carrier membership and a quotient class in H.
The inverse construction recovers each original carrier.

Taking the preimage of M/L returns M because M contains the quotient kernel L. This is the preimage-after-image identity of [the pinned quotient correspondence](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean#L284). The result identifies the same embedded carrier, not just an isomorphic quotient, and needs no nondegeneracy or isotropy. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L116) passes.
The image subgroup retains precisely the representatives from M.

The map M↦M/L and inverse H↦π⁻¹(H) give [the pinned quotient correspondence](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean#L284) for L⊆M⊆Lᵛ. This is the carrier correspondence underlying [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8); additional isotropy conditions are imposed only in the integral/even versions. The order is preserved, and the construction remains valid without nondegeneracy. Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L208) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L215) passes, [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L237) passes.
One round trip recovers the subgroup.
The other recovers the carrier.
Containment is preserved and reflected.

For x∈Lᵛ, its class belongs to M/L exactly when x belongs to M: differing by an element of L cannot change membership because L⊆M. This is the representative criterion of [the pinned quotient correspondence](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean#L284), matching the quotient subgroup in [Nikulin §1.4](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=1677&what=fullteng#page=8). Published [control](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/93d1fe508e122e53ce5538a8a3994c290753f127/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/Overlattice/Basic.lean#L215) passes.
Recovering M from its quotient subgroup uses this same carrier identification.

A supplied dual-carrier representative lies in L_H exactly when its quotient class lies in H. This is the defining inverse-image membership condition in [the pinned quotient correspondence](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean#L284). Composing a path from x to y with a continuous map gives a path from f(x) to f(y). Paths from x to y and from y to z concatenate to a path from x to z. Reversing a path inside F exchanges its endpoints while preserving its image. The source passes through the equivalent path relation on the subtype F, so the reversed witness still lies in F throughout. Compared with [§8.2, p.51, inverse path t↦γ(1−t)](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L229).

Two paths inside the same subset F with a common endpoint concatenate inside F. The source uses transitivity in the subtype, which preserves the full containment condition and gives endpoints x and z in the stated order. Compared with [Equation8.1, p.51, concatenation](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L237).

A path lying in U also lies in any larger set V. The source reuses the same chosen path and applies U⊆V pointwise, retaining its endpoints and continuity. Thus the direction of monotonicity matches the subspace path condition. Compared with [Definition7.1, p.40, paths inside subsets](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L222).

Compared with [Definition7.1, p.40](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf); [§1.1, p.25, bundled path content](https://pi.math.cornell.edu/~hatcher/AT/ATch1.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L600).

The endpoints of an actual path determine the same class in ZerothHomotopy. The quotient relation is existence of a path, so the supplied path proves that relation directly. This is exactly equality of the two path components in π₀. Compared with [§4.1, p.340, π₀ convention](https://pi.math.cornell.edu/~hatcher/AT/ATch4.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L138).

The range of a continuous map from a path-connected space is path connected: compose source paths with the map and regard their images as lying in its range. Source nonemptiness supplies a range point, so the nonempty convention in IsPathConnected is preserved. Compared with [Definition7.1, p.40; continuous-composition argument checked in source](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L618).

The membership orientation in the hypothesis is y to x. Compared with [Exercise7.1, p.45, path components partition the space](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L318).

PathConnectedSpace is equivalent to path connectedness of the universal subset. The source expands both definitions to the same pairwise path condition and the same nonemptiness requirement; paths restricted to the universal set add no constraint. Compared with [Definition7.1, p.40; Lean’s nonempty convention checked explicitly](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L608).

The underlying set of the identity path-component subgroup is exactly the path component of 1. The source defines its inherited submonoid carrier by that set; the generated coercion lemma exposes this value without replacing path components by connected components. Compared with [Definition7.1, p.40, path-component convention; subgroup carrier checked in source](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L397).

Membership of x in the path component of y means that a path runs from y to x. This follows directly from the carrier definition and agrees with the usual path-component relation. Symmetry is available separately, but the displayed direction is preserved exactly. Compared with [Definition7.1 and Exercise7.1, pp.40,45](https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~wendl/Sommer2026/Topologie1/lecturenotes.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L294).

The real line is path connected via the explicit segment t↦(1−t)x+ty. The source verifies continuity and both endpoints and supplies nonemptiness separately. This is the usual convex-space path argument, including the constant segment when x=y. Compared with [Example1.1, p.25, continuous linear interpolation](https://pi.math.cornell.edu/~hatcher/AT/ATch1.pdf) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/PathConnected.lean#L638).

The relative connected component is always preconnected. When x∈F, it is the image of a connected component in the subspace F under the inclusion; when x∉F, it is defined to be empty and remains preconnected. The weaker adjective is therefore necessary without a membership premise. Compared with [Lemma5.7.3, components in the subspace; empty convention checked in source](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/004T) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/Basic.lean#L538).

A point belonging to F belongs to its connected component in F. The source identifies that component with the inclusion-image of the subtype component through the corresponding point. This is the usual component-through-a-point property in the relative topology. Compared with [Lemma5.7.3(4), applied to F](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/004T) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/Basic.lean#L519).

A connected component taken within F is a subset of F. In the membership branch it is the image of a subtype-valued component, whose values lie in F; in the other branch it is empty. This matches the declared relative-component construction in all cases. Compared with [Lemma5.7.3, components of the subspace F](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/004T) and the [pinned source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/Basic.lean#L531).
